SELECT AA.INDEX_SN /*번호*/ ,AA.SRVC_NM /*서비스명*/ ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.SRVC_BGNG_YMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SRVC_BGNG_YMD /*서비스시작기간*/ ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.SRVC_END_YMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SRVC_END_YMD /*서비스종료기간*/ ,AA.CONM_NM /*신청회사*/ ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.APLY_BGNG_YMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS APLY_BGNG_YMD /*신청시작일자*/ ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.APLY_END_YMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS APLY_END_YMD /*신청종료일자*/ ,C##RG.DEC_B64(DD.FLNM_ENCPT) AS USER_NM /*신청자명*/ ,TO_CHAR(AA.ANS_SNDNG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ANS_SNDNG_DT /*답신발송일시*/ ,AA.ANS_INST_NO /*답신기관코드*/ ,BB.INST_NM /*답신기관명*/ ,AA.PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD /*상태*/ FROM PAA200 AS AA /*민간지원서비스*/ LEFT OUTER JOIN SAA000 AS BB /*통합기관*/ ON AA.ANS_INST_NO = BB.INST_NO /*기관코드*/ INNER JOIN SAA200 AS CC /*유저*/ ON AA.USER_ID = CC.USER_ID INNER JOIN SCA200 AS DD ON CC.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = DD.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO WHERE 1=1
AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{SEARCH_ITEM_NM} /* 번호 */
AND AA.CONM_NM LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_ITEM_NM}||'%' /*신청회사*/
AND AA.USER_ID LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_ITEM_NM}||'%' /*신청자*/
AND AA.ANS_INST_NO = #{INST_NO}
AND AA.PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD = #{PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD}
AND AA.APLY_BGNG_YMD >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AA.APLY_END_YMD <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE}, 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT INDEX_SN /*글 번호*/ ,C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.FLNM_ENCPT) AS USER_NM /*신청자명*/ ,C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS USER_PHONENUM /*신청자핸드폰*/ ,C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS USER_EMAIL /*신청자이메일*/ ,AA.CONM_NM /*상호명*/ ,C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.RPRSV_NM_ENCPT) AS RPRSV_NM_ENCPT /*대표자명*/ ,AA.BRNO /*사업자등록번호*/ ,AA.SALS_ACCDT_CN /*업태*/ ,AA.SALS_KND_CN /*업종(종목)*/ ,CONCAT(GG.CTPV_NM,CONCAT(' ',GG.SGG_NM)) AS SGG_NM /*지역*/ ,AA.SRVC_NM /*서비스명*/ ,AA.SRVC_TRGT_NM /*서비스 대상*/ ,CONCAT(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.SRVC_BGNG_YMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD'),CONCAT(' ~ ',TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.SRVC_END_YMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS SRVC_YMD /*서비스 기간*/ ,CONCAT(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.APLY_BGNG_YMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD'),CONCAT(' ~ ',TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.APLY_END_YMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS APLY_YMD /*서비스 신청 기간*/ ,AA.PIC_CTTPC_ENCPT /*담당자 연락처*/ ,AA.PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT /*담당자 이메일*/ ,AA.SRVC_DTL_CN /*제공 서비스 설명*/ ,FF.INST_NM /*답변기관*/ ,C##RG.DEC_B64(DD.FLNM_ENCPT)||' '||(SELECT USER_ID FROM SAA200 WHERE DD.ENFSN_NO = ENFSN_NO) AS FLNM_ENCPT /*답변자명*/ ,AA.ANS_SNDNG_DT /*답변발송일시*/ ,TO_CHAR(AA.ANS_SNDNG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS S_ANS_SNDNG_DT /*답변발송일시*/ ,AA.PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD /*진행상태코드*/ ,AA.PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD2 /*진행상태코드(BEFORE)*/ ,AA.ANS_CN /*답변내용*/ ,AA.ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ FROM PAA200 AA /*민간기관지원서비스*/ INNER JOIN SAA200 BB /*사용자*/ ON AA.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID INNER JOIN SCA200 CC /*청소년보호자*/ ON BB.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = CC.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN SCA100 DD /*종사자*/ ON AA.ANS_ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN SAA000 FF /*통합기관*/ ON AA.ANS_INST_NO = FF.INST_NO INNER JOIN SAA020 GG /*시군구코드*/ ON AA.SGG_CD = GG.SGG_CD AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
mapper.update: UPDATE PAA200 SET ANS_INST_NO = #{ANS_INST_NO} /*답변기관코드*/ ,ANS_ENFSN_NO = #{ANS_ENFSN_NO} /*답변종사자번호*/ ,ANS_SNDNG_DT = #{ANS_SNDNG_DT} /*답변발송일시*/ ,PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD = #{PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD} /*진행상태구분코드*/ ,ANS_CN = #{ANS_CN} /*답변내용*/ WHERE INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
